phase_balance.definitions: On normalized T3 let f_N be a real trigonometric polynomial with Fourier support |k|_2<=N, s_N=sgn(f_N), delta_N=int(f_N^2-1)^2 and H_(alpha,N)=sum_(alpha N<=|k|_2<=N)|hat s_N(k)|^2 for fixed 0<alpha<1
phase_balance.tail_bridge: The pointwise identity |s_N-f_N|=||f_N|-1| and |f_N|+1>=1 give ||s_N-f_N||_2^2<=delta_N; Fourier best approximation therefore gives sum_(|k|_2>N)|hat s_N(k)|^2<=delta_N
phase_balance.variance_bridge: Writing p_N=mu{s_N=-1}, Parseval gives H_(alpha,N)<=sum_(k!=0)|hat s_N(k)|^2=1-|int s_N|^2=4p_N(1-p_N)
phase_balance.phase_floor: If H_(alpha,N)>=eta>0 then min(p_N,1-p_N)>=eta/4, so both sign phases have macroscopic normalized volume
phase_balance.good_core: On {|f_N|<1/2} the defect density is at least 9/16; if delta_N<=9eta/128, each core {f_N>=1/2} and {f_N<=-1/2} has volume at least eta/8
phase_balance.scope_guard: Outer-shell mass supplies phase balance and an above-cutoff tail bound; it does not by itself estimate the thickness of the transition set, prove a sharp exponent or identify a Gaussian weighted capacity
